product_id.title: Product ID
product_id.description: Product ID on the Pismo platform. The ID is in the UUID v4 format.

interest_plan_id.title: Interest plan ID
interest_plan_id.description: Your interest plan ID on the Pismo platform. Displayed in the UUID v4 format.

status.title: Status
status.description: Overdraft product status. The status of a new product's status is always `CREATED`.

created_at.title: Product creation datetime
created_at.description: Overdraft product creation datetime. Emitted as a Unix epoch in nanoseconds (integer). The string form is retained for backward compatibility.

interest_processing_code.title: Interest processing code
interest_processing_code.description: Processing code used to identify interest-related transactions such as interest accrual, charging, and reversals on the overdraft balance.
